LESSON: WRITING WRITING SKILLS

Grade: PP2
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.2: Writing WRITING skills

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Writing WRITING skills. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: where they turn pages from right to left as books when writing?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Turn pages from right to left during a writing activity in and out of class. with the right grip. 34
2. Take pleasure in pre- writing activities in and out of class. where they write line and cursive patterns from left to right across a line and filling each page from top to the bottom. demonstrating appropriate pencil grip and imitate the same.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Turn pages from right to left during a writing activity in and out of class. with the right grip. 34
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to turn pages from right to left during a writing activity in and out of class. with the right grip. 34. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Take pleasure in pre- writing activities in and out of class. where they write line and cursive patterns from left to right across a line and filling each page from top to the bottom. demonstrating appropriate pencil grip and imitate the same.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to take pleasure in pre- writing activities in and out of class. where they write line and cursive patterns from left to right across a line and filling each page from top to the bottom. demonstrating appropriate pencil grip and imitate the same. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: When you meet your teacher in the morning, say “Good morning” clearly and smile.

Example 2: Listen to a short story about a child walking to school. Then tell a friend one thing that happened.

Example 3: Write three sentences about your school using new words from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Writing WRITING skills.
2. Explain Writing WRITING skills to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Writing WRITING skills.
4. Show that you can: Turn pages from right to left during a writing activity in and out of class. with the right grip. 34
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Writing WRITING skills. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: where they turn pages from right to left as books when writing?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Turn pages from right to left during a writing activity in and out of class. with the right grip. 34
2. Take pleasure in pre- writing activities in and out of class. where they write line and cursive patterns from left to right across a line and filling each page from top to the bottom. demonstrating appropriate pencil grip and imitate the same.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
